adhkar.text_arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ مَا تَعْلَمُ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of what You know,

adhkar.text_arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا تَعْلَمُ.
adhkar.translation: and I seek refuge in You from the evil of what You know,
and I seek Your forgiveness for everything You know,

adhkar.text_arabic: إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَعْلَمُ، وَأَنْتَ عَلَّامُ الْغُيُوبِ.
adhkar.translation: for You indeed know and we do not know, and indeed You are the Knower of the Unseen.

adhkar.text_arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ ارْحَمْنِي مِنْ زَمَانِي هَذَا وَإِحْدَاقِ الْفِتَنِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, have mercy on me in this time from the encirclement of discord,

adhkar.text_arabic: وَتَطَاوُلِ أَهْلِ الْجُرْأَةِ عَلَيَّ وَاسْتِضْعَافِهِمُ إِيَّايَ.
adhkar.translation: from the oppression of the insolent and their deficiencies and all such ills.

adhkar.text_arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنْكَ فِي عِيَاذٍ مَنِيعٍ وَحِرْزٍ حَصِينٍ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, give me an unassailable refuge in You, an impenetrable protection with You

adhkar.text_arabic: مِنْ جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ حَتَّى تُبَلِّغَنِيَ أَجَلِي مُعَافًى.
adhkar.translation: from all of Your creation until I come to a virtuous end.

adhkar.text_arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as many times as those who have asked for blessings upon him.
